title: The board stays on this machine unless asked, with a key you can rotate
summary: The board listens on 127.0.0.1 by default; board.host: network opens it on this machine's address found at each start (no network: 127.0.0.1, said so); a fixed address only via --host; board --new-key rotates the key (done 2026-11-21); the cookie lasts 30 days.
